images.name: RP-E-sol_a
images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct under-layer A. Image 1 is the ORIGINAL edit target, controlling exact alignment and all retained pixels. Image 2 shows the desired newly exposed armour design only. On Image 1 remove all blue/yellow tabard cloth, all flaps, red lining and heraldry, and fill its former area with steel breastplate, overlapping waist fauld, short hip mail skirt and rounded complete steel cuisses continuously connecting hips to existing knee cops as illustrated in Image 2. Preserve Image 1's helmet, gorget, arms, hands, weapon, visible knees, shins and both feet without any repainting or change. Keep original 1024x1536 canvas, pose, coordinates and proportions. Critical correction: background must be a single SOLID RGB(0,255,0) #00ff00 flat fill, with no mottling, texture, variation, gradients or shadow. Only the exposed garment-covered region is painted; every other source pixel is retained. Match source ink and watercolor hand precisely without restyling. No gaps at hip to thigh, no cloth remains, no text. Image 2 must not control the retained details: copy those unchanged from Image 1.

references.role: Original edit target and alignment reference
Initial A armour-design reference, supplied through out/RP-E-sol_a.png before replacement

images.name: RP-E-sol_b
images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make under-layer B from Image 1 (the tabard-free armour edit target). Image 2 is the original knight and controls exact retained helmet, hands, arm, weapon and higher foot details and locations. Perform a localized leg removal only: erase the near/foreground leg, including its thigh, spiked knee, long greave and the lowest foot. Reveal the far leg beneath it, painting its full rounded steel cuisse from hip joint under the mail, its knee and shin continuous into the existing higher right-pointing foot at y=1150. Only one complete far leg remains; no gaps. Do NOT redraw the upper knight or pollaxe or move their edges. Retain original higher foot precisely. Keep Image 1's breastplate, fauld and short mail skirt unchanged; no cloth or tabard returns. Keep 1024x1536 size and original composition and exact placement. Important targeted correction: the green is a perfectly uniform solid digital background RGB 0,255,0 (#00ff00), absolutely no watercolor paper texture on the green. The painted character alone has the source's ink, hatching and washes. Retained parts must be identical to their source pixels with no smoothing, recolouring, outline movement or new details. No text, shadows or other objects. Exact alignment for stacking is essential.
